**📅 August 19, 2026**
**📊 Market Sentiment:** Bearish
**🎯 Confidence:** High

**🧠 Key Themes**
• Treasury yields surging to multi-year highs on fiscal drift and debt-supply fears, hammering rate-sensitive tech valuations
• AI/chip stocks leading equity declines as the AI capex boom faces bubble-risk scrutiny and higher discount rates
• Iran/Hormuz stalemate escalating oil prices (Brent >$90) and raising stagflationary tail risks
• Consumer spending showing cracks with weak retail data and frozen housing conditions
• Bond vigilantes overriding Fed expectations, with traders hedging against a 2027 pivot while yields keep climbing

**⚠️ Notable Risks**
• Strait of Hormuz closure or direct military escalation causing an oil price shock
• US fiscal crisis/debt spiral forcing sustained higher yields and crowding out private investment
• Tariff escalation (50% on Canada) adding supply-chain inflation while growth slows

**📈 Volatility Outlook:** Rising

**🧾 One-Line Take**
A violent bond rout and Hormuz-driven oil spike are squeezing tech valuations and threatening stagflation, leaving the Fed trapped and option sellers exposed to regime-shift risk.
